key_insight: VFlash aims to make visual planning faster and more accurate by changing how models decode spatial primitives such as points, bounding boxes, and trajectories. Its Flash Primitive Decoding approach targets the cost of generating coordinates one token at a time.
problem_solved: Autoregressive vision-language models generate visual plans sequentially, making richer spatial predictions increasingly expensive for robotics and autonomous driving.
method: Represent spatial goals and anticipated motion using visual primitives rather than language alone.
Introduce Flash Primitive Decoding to address the inefficiency of coordinate-by-coordinate generation.
The supplied abstract is truncated, so detailed decoding mechanics and evaluation results are unavailable.
impact: More efficient visual-plan generation could help practitioners build responsive systems for robotics and autonomous driving. The supplied excerpt does not establish measured speedups or accuracy gains.
